hooks.basisCli.defaultMessage: As the coding agent lists them now for this session's settings. The session read its own when it started.
hooks.basisCli.description: Under What's loaded in the Hooks dialog: where the list comes from (the CLI's own listing, asked now).

hooks.basisLaunch.defaultMessage: As the session's settings files were when it started. The coding agent doesn't say which of them it loaded.
hooks.basisLaunch.description: Under What's loaded in the Hooks dialog: where the list comes from (its settings files, as read when the session started).

hooks.close.description: The Hooks dialog's button that closes it.

hooks.col.command.description: A column of the Hooks dialog: the command or address a hook runs.

hooks.col.event.description: A column of the Hooks dialog: the hook event (SessionStart, PreToolUse…).

hooks.col.ledger.description: A column of the Hooks dialog: what Combwork made of the hook for the agent's status (applied, or ignored and why).

hooks.col.ms.description: A column of the Hooks dialog: how long Combwork took to handle the hook (not how long a hook command ran).

hooks.col.reply.description: A column of the Hooks dialog: what Combwork answered the hook.

hooks.col.source.description: A column of the Hooks dialog: where a hook comes from (Combwork, the user, the project…).

hooks.col.status.description: A column of the Hooks dialog: whether the hook is loaded, and how sure Combwork is.

hooks.col.time.description: A column of the Hooks dialog: when Combwork received a hook.

hooks.count.description: In the Hooks dialog, before a hook event shown once for several alike in a row ("34 × Stop").

hooks.firedHeading.description: A heading in the Hooks dialog, over the hooks Combwork received from the agent's session.

hooks.firedWhat.defaultMessage: Combwork's own hooks it received, newest first (the last 50): Combwork's reply, and what Combwork made of it. Other hooks aren't seen by Combwork.
hooks.firedWhat.description: Under What fired in the Hooks dialog.

hooks.ledger.defaultMessage: {ledger, select, applied {Applied} continued {Carried on by Combwork} ignored {Ignored} other {Not reached}}
hooks.ledger.description: What Combwork made of a hook for the agent's status, in the Hooks dialog's Taken as column. Ignored is followed by why (an earlier turn's, a duplicate…).

hooks.loadWhat.description: Fills "Could not load {what}" when the Hooks dialog fails to load.

hooks.loadedHeading.description: A heading in the Hooks dialog, over the hooks the agent's session has.

hooks.loading.description: The Hooks dialog while it reads the agent's hooks.

hooks.ms.description: How long Combwork took to handle a hook, in milliseconds, in the Hooks dialog.

hooks.noneFired.description: Under What fired in the Hooks dialog, before any hook came.

hooks.notObserved.description: In the Hooks dialog, under a hook that isn't Combwork's: Combwork never sees when it runs.

hooks.notRunning.defaultMessage: The agent isn't running: its hooks are listed while it runs.
hooks.notRunning.description: The Hooks dialog for an agent that isn't running.

hooks.note.changed.defaultMessage: {file} has changed since the session started. This list is the session's start; what it loads now isn't known.
hooks.note.changed.description: A note in the Hooks dialog: a settings file changed after the session started.

hooks.note.cliUnknown.defaultMessage: The coding agent couldn't list its hooks ({why}): only Combwork's are shown, and whether others load isn't known.
hooks.note.cliUnknown.description: A note in the Hooks dialog: asking the CLI for its hooks failed. {why} says why (the CLI's or the system's words).

hooks.note.more.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {# more hook} other {# more hooks}} not listed.
hooks.note.more.description: A note in the Hooks dialog: a source has more hooks than the dialog lists.

hooks.note.notJson.defaultMessage: {file} isn't valid JSON, so the coding agent skips it: its hooks aren't listed.
hooks.note.notJson.description: A note in the Hooks dialog: a settings file isn't JSON.

hooks.note.othersUnread.defaultMessage: The coding agent may also load hooks Combwork doesn't read (its own plugins, the folder's). Only Combwork's are listed.
hooks.note.othersUnread.description: A note in the Hooks dialog for a CLI whose other hooks Combwork doesn't read.

hooks.note.unreadable.defaultMessage: {file} couldn't be read ({why}): its hooks aren't listed.
hooks.note.unreadable.description: A note in the Hooks dialog: a settings file Combwork couldn't read. {why} says why.

hooks.note.unsure.description: A note in the Hooks dialog: an argument that leaves Combwork unsure what the CLI reads ({what}, such as --bare) and why.

hooks.receiver.description: In the Hooks dialog, under a hook event: which of Combwork's hooks it came through. {form} is its form (http, command): keep it.

hooks.refresh.description: The Hooks dialog's button that reads the agent's hooks again.

hooks.response.defaultMessage: {response, select, none {Nothing to say} context {Sent context} allowed {Allowed} warned {Allowed, with a warning} asked {Asked you} blocked {Blocked} error {Error} other {Unknown}}
hooks.response.description: Combwork's reply to a hook, in the Hooks dialog's Combwork's reply column. Allowed is only what Combwork answered, not any other hook's answer.

hooks.snippet.allowlists.defaultMessage: If the managed settings set allowedHttpHookUrls, add {url} to it; if they set httpHookAllowedEnvVars, add CW_HOOK_TOKEN.
hooks.snippet.allowlists.description: The admin snippet dialog: what else an administrator adds when their settings restrict hooks. Keep the setting names, {url} (a web address) and CW_HOOK_TOKEN as they are.

hooks.snippet.close.description: Button closing the admin snippet dialog.

hooks.snippet.copied.description: A notice after copying the admin snippet (a block of Claude Code settings for an administrator).

hooks.snippet.copy.description: Button in the admin snippet dialog: copies the snippet to the clipboard.

hooks.snippet.guide.description: Button in the admin snippet dialog: opens the user guide's section on where an administrator pastes it. The … says it opens something: keep it.

hooks.snippet.loadWhat.description: What couldn't be loaded, in a 'couldn't load …' message of the admin snippet dialog.

hooks.snippet.notListening.defaultMessage: Combwork's Agent API isn't listening on port {port} now (another program may be using it), so hooks sent there won't reach Combwork until it is.
hooks.snippet.notListening.description: The admin snippet dialog: a warning that the port the snippet names is not open now. {port} is a number shown as it is.

hooks.snippet.otherPort.defaultMessage: Also for {build, select, dev {a development build} other {the installed app}} of Combwork (port {port})
hooks.snippet.otherPort.description: A checkbox in the admin snippet dialog: also add hooks for the other kind of Combwork (a development build, or the installed app) on its own port. {port} is a number shown as it is.

hooks.snippet.port.defaultMessage: Its hooks name Combwork's Agent API port, {port}. If that port changes (Settings → Agent API), the administrator pastes a new snippet.
hooks.snippet.port.description: The admin snippet dialog: the snippet names a network port ({port}, a number shown as it is). Settings → Agent API is where it's set, as Combwork shows it.

hooks.snippet.statusLine.defaultMessage: Include Combwork's status line (cost, plan limits, model). It replaces any status line the organisation's managed settings set, in every Claude Code session on the computer, and shows nothing.
hooks.snippet.statusLine.description: A checkbox in the admin snippet dialog: whether the snippet also sets Claude Code's status line, which Combwork reads cost and limits from.

hooks.snippet.title.description: Title of the dialog with the admin snippet: a block of Claude Code settings an organisation's administrator pastes into its managed settings so Combwork's hooks run where policy allows only managed hooks.

hooks.snippet.what.defaultMessage: Where an organisation's Claude Code policy allows only managed hooks (allowManagedHooksOnly), Combwork's own hooks don't run, and Combwork can't tell what its agents are doing. An administrator can paste this block into the organisation's managed settings once: it gives Claude Code Combwork's hooks for every session, every account and every project, and does nothing in sessions Combwork didn't start. It holds no password or token.
hooks.snippet.what.description: The admin snippet dialog: what the block is for. Keep allowManagedHooksOnly as it is (a setting name).

hooks.source.defaultMessage: {source, select, combwork {Combwork} managed {Managed settings} cli {Command line} project {Project} local {Project (local)} user {User} plugin {Plugin} other {Other}}
hooks.source.description: Where a hook comes from, in the Hooks dialog's From column.

hooks.stale.defaultMessage: The agent has restarted since this was read: it shows its earlier session.
hooks.stale.description: The Hooks dialog, when the agent restarted after its hooks were read; a Refresh link follows.

hooks.status.defaultMessage: {status, select, passed {Passed by Combwork} trusted {Trusted} untrusted {Not trusted: won't run} modified {Changed since trusted: won't run} unverified {Configured · loading unverified} disabled {Turned off} notLoaded {Not loaded} unsupported {Unknown form} other {Unknown}}
hooks.status.description: How sure Combwork is that a hook is loaded, in the Hooks dialog's Loaded column. Trusted, Not trusted and Changed since trusted are the coding agent's own trust in a hook.

hooks.timeSpan.description: In the Hooks dialog, the times of the first and last of several hooks alike shown as one row.

hooks.title.description: The title of an agent's Hooks dialog (its ⋯ menu → Hooks…). {agent} is the agent's name.

hooks.truncated.description: In the Hooks dialog, after a hook's command that was too long to show whole.

hooks.what.defaultMessage: The hooks this agent's session has, and what Combwork received from them. Combwork only shows them here: it never changes or turns off a hook.
hooks.what.description: What an agent's Hooks dialog shows (at its top).
